deleteConfirmDescription: Are you sure you want to delete this row?
Name: Name
dtPagePropsIntro: Start here for DataTable usage. Install the package, then use the props reference below to configure behavior and styling.
dtPagePropsSetup: Minimal setup: tableId, rowKey, columnsInfo, dataSource, pagination. Use serverMode for server-driven paging/search/filter/sort; add paginationState, sortState, onPageChange, and onSortChange when you control state from outside.
dtPageBasicDesc: Search, client pagination, column resize, column visibility, and row actions with delete confirmation.
dtPageBasicSetup: Uses paginationState + onPageChange, searchValue + onSearch, columnResize, and actions with deleteModalConfig.
dtPageGroupsDesc: Use Group by to switch between department and role; groupConfig updates getGroupLabel and order. Group order follows groupConfig.order when provided.
dtPageUsersDemoDesc: Flat table (no grouping) showcasing column render: avatars via Dicebear, Ant Design Tags and Tooltip, icons, localized dates with dayjs, and Typography. Use the Row groups demo to experiment with groupConfig.
dtPageUsersDemoSetup: columnsInfo uses render for most columns: Avatar + stacked name/email, colored Tags for role and status, map icon + location, dayjs absolute + relative joined date. See Row groups for getGroupLabel and Group by.
dtPageFiltersDesc: Multi-select and date presets in the toolbar. Wire filterValues and onFilterChange for controlled filters.
dtPageFiltersSetup: filters: multi options for status and category; date filter on Updated. This demo filters the dataset in memory based on filter state.
dtPageSelectionDesc: Selection column, per-row and bulk bookmark, and refresh. Use onSelectionChange and onBookmarkChange to sync state.
dtPageSelectionSetup: onRefresh is passed to show the refresh control. Selection and bookmark keys are echoed above the table.
dtPageServerDesc: DummyJSON (dummyjson.com) exposes products with server-side limit, skip, sortBy, order, search (/products/search?q=…), and category (/products/category/:slug or search + category). Categories for the filter come from GET /products/categories. The table only maps the JSON response to rows—no client-side filtering or sorting.
dtPageServerSetup: Build the request URL from paginationState, debounced search, sortState (mapped to sortBy/order), and the first selected category slug when using the multi filter. Pass total from the API response to pagination.totalItems. If several categories are selected, only the first is sent (DummyJSON accepts one category per request).
dtPageServerLoadError: Could not load products from the API.
dtPageSortDesc: Click sortable headers to change order. In client mode, sorting is handled internally. In server mode, use onSortChange and pass sortState.
dtPageSortSetup: Set sortable: true on columns. For server sorting, pass serverMode + sortState + onSortChange and return sorted rows from your API.
dtPageColorsDesc: Use customColors to override light mode, dark mode, and primary accent colors.
dtPageColorsSetup: customColors={{ primaryColor, lightMode, darkMode }}. Use top theme toggle to switch light and dark previews.
dtPageLoadingDesc: Pass loading to show Ant Design’s table loading overlay. Toggle below to preview.
dtPageLoadingSetup: loading={boolean}. Typically tied to an async fetch lifecycle.
dtPageLayoutDesc: maxTableHeight keeps the header and footer fixed while the table body scrolls. Also demonstrates onRowClick, renderToolbarLeft, renderToolbarRight, className, disableSelectionAndBookmark, and hideColumnOptions.
dtPageLayoutSetup: maxTableHeight="min(320px, 45vh)" with page size 50 so many rows stay on one page and scroll inside the body. Toggle hide columns to try hideColumnOptions.
dtLayoutClickHint: Click a data row to trigger onRowClick.
dtPagePlaygroundDesc: Paste a JSON array of row objects, optionally define columns, then toggle props and watch the table update. JSON is validated as you work; use the toolbar buttons to format or load samples. The live preview stays pinned beside the controls while you scroll, so you can edit at the bottom and still see the table.
dtPagePlaygroundSetup: Rows must be a JSON array of objects with the same keys. Set row key to a field that is unique per row (e.g. id). Leave columns empty to infer headers from the first row, or paste columns with id, label, and dataIndex.
dtPlaygroundRowsHelp: Paste an array like [{ "id": 1, "name": "…" }, …]. Invalid JSON shows an error below.
dtPlaygroundErr_notArray: Rows must be a JSON array.
dtPlaygroundErr_rowNotObject: Each row must be a non-null object.
dtPlaygroundErr_json: Invalid JSON. Check brackets, quotes, and commas.
dtPlaygroundColumnsHelp: Optional: array of { id, label, dataIndex, … }. Leave empty to infer columns from the first data row.
dtPlaygroundColumnsPlaceholder: Leave empty to infer from row data…
dtPlaygroundColErr_notArray: Columns must be a JSON array.
dtPlaygroundColErr_columnShape: Each column needs id, label, and dataIndex.
dtPlaygroundWarnRowKey: Some rows are missing the row key field — keys may be unstable.
dtPlaygroundFixJsonHint: Fix row or column JSON to see the live table.
dtPlaygroundLastClickEmpty: Click a data row in the table — the row key field value from the left panel is echoed here.
dtPlaygroundColumnsEmpty: Columns field is empty — inferring from data.
